patterns.message: Layering: domain must not depend on React; keep it pure TypeScript.
Layering: domain must not import application, adapters or UI (dependencies point inward).

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: domain must not do I/O; HTTP belongs in adapters/api.

no-restricted-globals.name: XMLHttpRequest
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: domain must not do I/O; HTTP belongs in adapters/api.

no-restricted-globals.name: window
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: domain must not touch browser globals.

no-restricted-globals.name: document
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: domain must not touch browser globals.

no-restricted-globals.name: localStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: domain must not touch browser globals.

no-restricted-globals.name: setTimeout
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: timers are ports; inject them instead of using setTimeout in domain.

no-restricted-globals.name: setInterval
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: timers are ports; inject them instead of using setInterval in domain.

patterns.message: Layering: application must not import adapters or UI; depend on ports and let main.tsx wire adapters.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: application must not call fetch; use a port implemented in adapters/api.

no-restricted-globals.name: XMLHttpRequest
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: application must not do HTTP; use a port implemented in adapters/api.

patterns.message: Layering: UI must not import adapters; receive data via application hooks or props wired in main.tsx.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: UI components never call fetch; use an application hook backed by adapters/api.

no-restricted-globals.name: XMLHttpRequest
no-restricted-globals.message: Layering: UI components never do HTTP; use an application hook backed by adapters/api.

patterns.message: Layering: adapters must not depend on React.
Layering: adapters must not import UI.
